name: new-hire-onboarding
description: End-to-end onboarding pipeline for new employees: collects documents and provisions accounts in parallel, then schedules training, and finally sends a personalized welcome package

agents.name: document-collector
agents.prompt: Collect all required onboarding documents for the new hire: {{employeeName}}, role: {{role}}, department: {{department}}, start date: {{startDate}}

agents.name: account-provisioner
agents.prompt: Provision all necessary accounts for: {{employeeName}}, role: {{role}}, department: {{department}}, manager: {{managerName}}

agents.name: training-scheduler
agents.prompt: Create a two-week training schedule for {{employeeName}} starting {{startDate}}. Role: {{role}}, team: {{department}}

agents.name: welcome-sender
agents.prompt: Compile the onboarding package for {{employeeName}} using the document checklist, provisioned accounts, and training schedule from previous steps
